notes.title: A special invitation to LET IT DIE: INFERNO
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/a76becd84f614ef323ecccb9445813ca336a0a0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Yo, Senpais!  [/p][p]You didn’t think you’d seen the last of me, did you?  Well, fear not, because I return with a special announcement just for you: LET IT DIE: INFERNO, a brand-new rogue-lite survival action game and addition to the LET IT DIE universe, is coming to you on 12/3 at 6 p.m. PST!  [/p][p]It’s time to step right down to the depths of Hell! Where previously, you climbed the Tower of Barbs, you will now instead make a dark and unforgiving descent into Hell Gate, a massive chasm that was the aftermath of an unprecedented cataclysm. And because you all pass my vibe check, I will let you in on some sick details about the game.  [/p][p]In LET IT DIE: INFERNO: [/p][list][*][p]Take on the role of a Raider, an immortal explorer, and embark on a quest to unearth the ultra-energy hidden deep within Hell Gate. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fend off grotesque creatures, human enemies, and real players in melee-focused PvEvP combat using a strategic combination of unique weapons that grant various special attacks. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Customize your Raider’s appearance by gathering and extracting resources to craft powerful weapons and robust armor.  [/p][/*][/list][p]In typical Hell fashion, we’ve spiced things up by making sure that no two runs will be the same! Item placements, enemies, and even your starting location will switch up every match, so do be sure to make smart choices and make it out alive! ... Or die and lose everything you’ve worked for.  [/p][p]Are you excited, Senpai?! I’m excited. We even have a fun little trailer so you can get a sneak peak of the fun we’re going to have together.  [/p][previewyoutube="aAS57BZ-fhA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Wishlist the game now so you don’t miss a beat: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/ "]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/ [/url][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576150/LET_IT_DIE_INFERNO/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]See you in Hell, [/p][p]Uncle Death  [/p]

notes.title: Version 4.9 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/527604c9dfe054da6469b5d35ea6285c0516330c.png[/img]

Senpai!

[b]At long last, it's here! Version 4.9, the last of the TENGOKU: Four Towers series![/b]



[h2][b]1) NEO M.I.L.K Area Revealed! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

After the maintenance on 5/28, for those of you that have made it to Floor 100 of TENGOKU, you’ll be presented with an escalator on Floor 51 that leads to the NEO M.I.L.K area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/821244e31f8fd50bc3e081931d8dd8c2ad5c3bf2.jpg[/img]

The NEO M.I.L.K area coming this patch is an extremely challenging area where all enemies are significantly strengthened, even by TENGOKU standards. Within the area, all M.I.L.K armor and weapons will receive a large faction bonus buff to their stats. It is highly recommended that players bring all M.I.L.K equipment when stepping up to this challenge. But select your items carefully before climbing up these floors; there will be a limit to the number of items you can take in your Death Bag.

Of course, with an immense challenge comes immense rewards. Within the area, players have increased chances of obtaining rare M.I.L.K metals, and the equipment obtained here is of similar quality to that of TENGOKU Floor 100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/d8c0e18e8cdb6121c26398fa2cfa57fc7c226f10.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]2) Pale Wind (HELL) Unleashed! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

The NEO M.I.L.K area features a new difficulty of a returning boss: Pale Wind of the 4 FORCEMEN can now be fought at the "HELL" difficulty! He'll appear every 10 floors that you progress within the NEO M.I.L.K area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/91ea0d6ac1924431f394b69def06f1ab73cfe19d.jpg[/img]

Defeat this high-difficulty FORCEMEN for rare items and new blueprints! Luckily, the "HELL" difficulty has no battle fee and no time limit during battles. However, if you are defeated, there will be a corpse retrieval cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/edce1bc55efd03c7816d26df374e0504cf23e56b.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]3) Bloodnium Limit Increased! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

The Bloodnium limit has been increased from 99999  to 999999!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/8314943f0a08b115b3fa25a137f4b32b15eff07f.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]4) NEO M.I.L.K Area Opening Event Will Be Held at the Same Time! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance) – 6/30/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

[url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7360/]Click here for more information[/url]



NOTE
*Please note that event duration and content may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances.

Are your hearts pounding from all the goretastic action in the tower? Or is it because of...the love in the air?

My Bloody Valentine returns again this year! Collect Heartshrooms during the event period to get your hands on these sweet rewards!

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website:[/i] [url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7345/]https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7345/[/url]

[b]How to accept quests:[/b]

By entering the Vanishing Point (the fountain) in the middle of your Waiting Room, you will be transported to the HATED ARCADE. There, by talking to Naomi Detox, you can accept quests from the device next to her. You can also accept quests by using the SUPER SCOPE 703 in your Waiting Room.

[list]

[*] A quest will remain accepted until it is completed, canceled, or the event period ends.
[*] To remain eligible for quest rewards you must complete all quest conditions before the event period ends and without canceling the quest.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Celebrating 8 Years of LET IT DIE!
notes.notes:
[i]8th Anniversary Event Duration: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/f87167fba7fc84ce4dc45f256fd940014e90c24e.png[/img]

Yo, Senpai!

[b]LET IT DIE celebrates its 8th anniversary on 12/4/2024!*[/b]

LET IT DIE, my baby, is now 8—the symbol of infinite chaos! Time flies when you're having fun... No tears here, I swear! I don't even have eyes! (Or maybe I do?)

This year's anniversary event is set to be a sick one, packed with some seriously epic surprises to mark 8 years of unforgettable mayhem.

Thank you, Senpai, for making these years so deadly fun—let's keep it going!

[i]*LET IT DIE was released in the U.S./Europe on 12/4/2016.[/i]





[h2][b]● Additional item for redecorating the Waiting Room![/b][/h2]

An additional free item has been added to celebrate the LET IT DIE 8th anniversary!
The item is redeemable after the start of the event with no time restriction.
Please check inside the [Metro Front]-[Waiting Room]-[Remodel]

"Promotion Poster Momoko"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/eb557fdacfc6bc094ab75a68a6395aef680367da.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary Special Login Bonuses[/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance)– 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

For a little over a month, we will hold special 8th anniversary login bonuses where you can get gorgeous items every day. If you log in during the event period, you’ll get the following the first time you log-in!

[list]
[*] Revived Item: "X-RATED Glasses (Blueprint)"
[*] Lost Bag: Rainbow×3 bags
[*] 200,000 Kill Coins (40,000 Kill Coins x 5)
[*] 200,000 SPLithium (40,000 SPLithium x 5)
[/list]

The X-RATED Glasses finally make their return!
These funky shades will raise a Fighter’s STR and STM by 6%!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0458558a07ddc40370aac8b5cb99ecaebf605d0b.jpg[/img]

In addition, depending on the day and time you logged in and the floor you reach in the Tower of Barbs, you will receive many more items!

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website[/i]: 
https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7286/


Notes:
[list]
[*] During the event, the regular daily log-in bonuses will be replaced with the bonuses outlined above.
[*] Storage space inside the Reward Box is limited. If the number of items in your Reward Box exceeds the maximum number of available storage slots, you will need to remove some items from your Reward Box in order to receive new items.
[/list]




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary MushFests![/b][/h2]
Event Periods:
– 11/28/2024 18:00 – 12/9/2024 17:59 (PST)
– 12/12/2024 18:00  – 12/23/2024 17:59 (PST)
– 12/26/2024 18:00 – 1/6/2025 17:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/315d78f347af43df3ab0096a0fdae43d06092604.png[/img]

There will be THREE extra special MushFests featuring ONLY 4★ and 5★ Skill Decals!

Not only that, but these ultra-special MushFest events will also feature the brand new decals. One “new decal” will be lined up for each event!


1st Round: Electro Beast
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/a8c03711009edd894159c9dca831838df91e76d3.png[/img]

2nd Round: Arch Wizard
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/7e687ab8d2c7358cd149ba515a312744fde29e21.png[/img]

3rd Round: Queen of Spades
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/9ba714e8300a434545abca4c3c5214b3fe1534f7.png[/img]

For more details, please view the lineup at the Mushroom Club during the event period.




[h2][b]● 3 Free Continues Per Day![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/28/2024 02:00 – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

If you accidentally die in the Tower of Barbs, you can continue up to 3 times a day! The count will be reset every day at 02:00 PST.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/3e0b77021fe87290c2a7a9e0b0ff8526f9f14d19.png[/img]




[h2][b]● 50% Off Sale at Vending Machine “HERNIA”![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/28/2024 02:00 – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

For a limited time, Vending Machine “HERNIA” in your Waiting Room, will have items and mushrooms on sale for 50% off! Take advantage of this before you become 50% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/a6a24d3463783a2765d827dda5c241cf71208237.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]● FREE Dustin on TENGOKU and NEO Boss Floors![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

During the event, all Dustin units on Tengoku and NEO boss floors (55F, 60F, 65F, etc.) will change from Dustin 5 to Dustin TD. Smash your way through these areas without worrying about filling up your inventory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0a67762077469c5000041ae62c37992d1251041c.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]● Earn 3x the Bloodnium in TENGOKU & NEO Areas![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

During this period, the amount of Bloodnium that can be obtained by defeating Enemies that appear in the TENGOKU and NEO areas will be tripled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/3a9b85a7d057aa2dbefcc5b159ed408229093ed5.png[/img]
Items such as “Splattershroom” are not included.




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary Special Quests Available![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/28/2024 02:00 – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

Special Quests will be available throughout the event period.
You can collect all types of rare metals repeatedly through those quests! Don’t miss this opportunity to power up your gear to another level!

[b][How to accept the quests][/b]
Talk to Naomi Detox at the HATED ARCADE, or access Superscope 703 to accept the quests.

[i]Additional details about the quests can be viewed on our website:[/i] 
https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7286/




[h2][b]● Limited Time Event: INTO THE PIT[/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/30/2024 02:00 – 1/5/2025 01:59 (PST)[/i]

KNIGHT RIDERS are back! Can you snag their blueprints and make it back to your Waiting Room in one piece?

notes.title: Version 4.0 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0500afe39edb1f2ab0c8b37a70562159625e8904.jpg[/img]

Senpai!

[b]At long last, it's here! Version 4.0 with a major update![/b]

Honestly, I was convinced there wouldn't be any more big updates... This is all thanks to all you senpai who have continued playing the game! Thanks, y'all!

After years of hard work, a new area is finally releasing: the NEO D.O.D. area! The NEO D.O.D. area is a brand new high-difficulty area where all enemies are significantly strengthened. It's a high risk, high reward challenge that adrenaline junkies are bound to  love.

By the way, it seems that you can't challenge the NEO D.O.D. area unless you've reached TENGOKU 100F, so if you haven't done that yet, go conquer TENGOKU first! I'll be waiting!



[h2][b]1) NEO D.O.D. Area Revealed![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

After the maintenance on 11/29, for those of you that have made it to Floor 100 of TENGOKU, you’ll be presented with an escalator on Floor 51 that leads to the NEO D.O.D. area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/cf04277e9f8cd8955ed63722fd6ad4952e65af2b.jpg[/img]

The Neo D.OD. area coming this patch is an extremely challenging area where all enemies are significantly strengthened, even by TENGOKU standards. Within the area, all D.O.D. armor and weapons will receive a large faction bonus buff to their stats. It is highly recommended that players bring all D.O.D. equipment when stepping up to this challenge. But select your items carefully before climbing up these floors; there will be a limit to the number of items you can take in your Death Bag.

Of course, with an immense challenge comes immense rewards. Within the area, players have increased chances of obtaining rare D.O.D. ARMS metals, and the equipment obtained here is of similar quality to that of TENGOKU floor 100.

NOTE                                                                                                                                    
*Other faction stages will also be releasing in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/d0cdcd79d31edb49e171925d40cd146edf8f9478.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]2) White Steel (HELL) Unleashed![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

The Neo D.O.D. area features a new difficulty of a returning boss: White Steel of the Four Forcemen can now be fought at the "HELL" difficulty! He'll appear every 10 floors that you progress within the NEO D.O.D. area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/cb99106ce079a04bcbd392c9fb0e384123fe6730.jpg[/img]

Defeat this high-difficulty Forcemen for rare items and new blueprints!

Unlike other difficulties, the "HELL" difficulty has no battle fee and no time limit during battles. However, if you are defeated, there will be a corpse retrieval cost.



[h2][b]3) Armor Skins In Shop![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

You'll now be able change the appearance of your Fighter's armor!

Armor Skins will be sliding into Let it Die with Version 4.0! The ability to set armor skins can be accessed by speaking to Kommodore Suzuki at the Choku-Funsha. You'll be able to select any armor enhanced up to +4 as armor skins, letting you conquer the tower with flair!

Armor skins only change the appearance of the armor. The performance of the skin will be the same as that of the armor you have equipped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/257db2edcf81fde96d9344eda085fa5347ad1bb6.jpg[/img]

The status of your armor skins can also be checked in the Option Menu. Armor skins can only be applied to the Fighter currently in play. Please note that "Armor Skins" will not be reflected on some screens, such as the floor results.

* For more details, please view the lineup at the Mushroom Club during the event periods.

During the event period, mushrooms and materials sold at Vending Machine "Hernia" will be 50% off!  Use this chance to level up your gear fast!

notes.notes:
[i]Event Period: 11/24/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 1/17/2022 (Maintenance Begins)[/i]

Greetings. Tetsuo’s the name.

Thank you for riding the Tokyo Death Metro.
Have you been enjoying TDM Battle Rush Season 16 so far?
This season will come to an end on [b]January 17th, 2022[/b].

As the end draws near, we’ll be revving things up to provide you with something even more exciting:

TDM Battle Rush: Season Finale!

To find out more about what’s coming to a train platform near you, please review the following details.

We greatly appreciate your business and hope you continue to enjoy the Tokyo Death Metro’s Luxury Attack Liner!

[h2][u][b]1. Finale Rank Rewards![/b][/u][/h2]
Players will receive a special blueprint based on their rank at the end of the Season Finale.
Aim for the top as higher ranks will result in better rewards!

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website:[/i] [url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/6032/]https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/6032/[/url]

The Diamond Rank FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM reward features +10% attack power and 50% greater durability compared to the base FFWF-103 Flamethrower TDM. In addition, the FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM can hold more ammunition and it requires fewer materials for R&D. It’s more economical AND it packs a real punch that you’ll have to feel to believe! Light ’em up and watch ’em burn, man! Please be aware that – compared to the original Flamethrower – the FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM will have a much longer wait time before another can be purchased at Chokufunsha.

notes.title: Let's Celebrate 7 Million Downloads!
notes.notes:
[i]Event Period: 9/27/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 10/28/2021[/i]

Yo, senpai!

Thanks to you, literally the best gaming community ever, LET IT DIE has reached 7 million downloads worldwide! To commemorate this badass achievement, I will be hosting a surprise celebration [b]throughout October 2021[/b]!

Thank you to everyone who watched our announcement video! I have prepared a great event for all Senpai to participate in this event. It's called Hater Funding! I am counting the number of Hater that senpai have killed during the event. The current number of defeats will be updated about once a week after the event starts.

[h2][u][b]11,228,088[/b][/u] (as of 10/28/2021)[/h2]
Thanks to everyone’s cooperation, we achieved our final goal of 7,000,000 overall defeats before the end of the event!

Moving on, for every 1,000,000 defeats, an additional bonus will be applied as the “Hater Funding Stretch Goal”.

Let me explain the details!

[h3]1. Hater Funding[/h3]
[i]Event Period: 9/27/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 10/28/2021 07:59 (PDT)[/i]

Haters gonna hate, but the more you defeat during the anniversary event, the more rewards for you and your pals. For every tier cleared, all players will receive the achievements as login bonuses "5th Anniversary Event" [b]beginning November 24[/b].

Additional details and rewards can be viewed on our website: [url=https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/]https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/[/url]

[h3]2.Hater Funding Special Quests Available![/h3]
[i]Event Period: 9/27/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 10/28/2021 02:59 (PDT)[/i]

In conjunction with "Hater Funding", a special quest will be held for a limited time. Let's try to defeat the 7,000,000 Haters! Also, don’t miss this opportunity to kick a little ass and power up your gear to another level!

How to Accept Quests: Use the Superscope 703 in your Waiting Room or enter the Vanishing Point (fountain) in the center of your Waiting Room and talk to Naomi Detox at the Hated Arcade counter to accept quests.

Additional info and details: [url=https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/]https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/[/url]

[b]Note:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can request up to 10 quests at the same time.
[*] Please do not cancel quests until you clear their conditions.
[/list]

※ Storage space inside the Reward Box is limited. If the number of items in your Reward Box exceeds the maximum number of available storage slots, you will need to remove some items from your Reward Box in order to receive new items.

Additional info and details: [url=https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/]https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/[/url]

[h3]3. Welcome Bonus for New Players![/h3]
[i]Event Period: 9/27/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 10/28/2021 02:59 (PDT)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/2180fc51159fde14707122329616496ca11db46f.png[/img]

During the event period, all players who register a new LET IT DIE account on either PlayStation 4 or Steam (PC) will receive the items listed below! These gifts come in addition to the exciting daily rewards that all players will receive throughout the 7 Million Downloads Celebration! If you’ve been waiting to join the fun – or know someone who has the guts to challenge the Tower of Barbs –  now is a great time to jump in and get crazy! All newly registered players will receive:
[list]
[*] Masamune Blade TDM blueprint
[*] Death Metal x 20
[*] 40,000 Kill Coins x 5
[*] Golden Bird x 5
[*] 1-Day Express Pass x 5

Additional info and details: [url=https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/]https://letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5924/[/url]

[h3]4. Ultra-sick Login Bonuses![/h3]
[i]Event Period: 9/27/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 10/28/2021 02:59 (PDT)[/i]

Goretical daily login bonuses will be available throughout the celebration! For a full month, players will receive deluxe items every day! This is a great opportunity to power up your gear and blow away the Haters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/15f32cf4b14a45e75f4be029bd449bdb3f9f0976.png[/img]

Greetings. Tetsuo’s the name.

Thank you for riding the Tokyo Death Metro.
Have you been enjoying TDM Battle Rush Season 16 so far?
This season will come to an end on September 27, 2021.

As the end draws near, we’ll be revving things up to provide you with something even more exciting:

TDM Battle Rush: Season Finale!

To find out more about what’s coming to a train platform near you, please review the following details.

We greatly appreciate your business and hope you continue to enjoy the Tokyo Death Metro’s Luxury Attack Liner!

[h2][u][b]1. Finale Rank Rewards![/b][/u][/h2]
Players will receive a special blueprint based on their rank at the end of the Season Finale.
Aim for the top as higher ranks will result in better rewards!

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website:[/i] [url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5867/]https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/5867/[/url]

The Diamond Rank Bowling Crusher A TDM reward features +6% attack power and 40% greater durability compared to the base Bowling Crusher TDM. In addition, the Bowling Crusher A TDM requires fewer materials for R&D. It’s more economical AND it packs a real punch that you’ll have to feel to believe! No 7-10 splits with this one! Please be aware that the Bowling Crusher A TDM will have a much longer wait time before another piece can be purchased at Chokufunsha in comparison to the original Bowling Crusher.

[*] Bowling Crusher TDM, Bowling Stomper A TDM, and Bowling Stomper TDM can be upgraded to +4, but cannot advance to the next tier and are not eligible for Uncapping

[*] Special TDM Rank Rewards can be obtained from the Reward Box in the Waiting Room

In addition to that, he also said he's going to make his debut as a Youtuber?! I don't know when that's gonna happen either, but I wonder if he'll return to the Tower of Barbs before then?! Seriously, I need $.

notes.title: Uncle Death is Missing!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/41f708169034b927f31ce563c69b2775606b6172.png[/img]

Hey, um...senpais! Wow. So like, I’ve been trying to keep it a secret, but OMG, UNCLE DEATH IS MISSING!!

It all started a couple of months ago. Uncle D had been acting a little strangely and then one day he told me he was “going out for some tacos” and like, I haven’t seen him since! That is, I HADN’T seen him until this super mysterious videotape showed up at the HATED ARCADE. The postmark was dated a few weeks after he disappeared, so I guess it must have like, got lost in the mail or whatever.

Anyway, I’m trying not to be emo here, but the video is like, kinda disturbing. Uncle Death is… well, maybe you should just see the video.

[previewyoutube=vQNiHppwd_8;full][/previewyoutube]

So like, yeah, Uncle Death is living in some yucky basement somewhere and I still haven’t heard from him! I wouldn’t normally ask anyone for help under any circumstances, but I’m really worried about Uncle Death. I mean, like, what if he doesn’t come back? I might stop getting paid to come and sit in this stupid arcade all day!!

Uncle Death never stops talking about how much he loves his senpai, so that’s why I’m turning to you. PLEASE help me convince Uncle Death to return by sending your messages of support on social media using the hashtag #UncleDeathIsMissing. You can also post your comments on the YouTube video. Anything helps!

Tell him that you miss him! Tell him how much you enjoy his game. Tell him what he can do to make you happy! I think that, like, if hears from enough people that might convince him to come home, ya know?

Anyways, please follow Uncle Death on social media and send him your messages of support. Here are Uncle D’s social media accounts:

[url=twitter.com/LETITDIETheGame]Uncle Death's Twitter[/url]

[url=facebook.com/LETITDIETheGame]Uncle Death's Facebook[/url]

[url=instagram.com/letitdiethegame]Uncle Death's Instagram[/url]

Thanks in advance for your help. If you can’t do it for him, do it for ME! I’m stuck in this arcade with no one to talk to except stupid Meijin!

Kthanx,

Naomi Detox

notes.title: TDM Battle Rush: Season 9 Finale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/1b39a07a2c35f323c1a7919cb454a1327174d24d.png[/img]

[b]Event Period: 11/27/2019 (post maintenance) – 1/5/2020 (maintenance begins)[/b]

Greetings. Tetsuo’s the name.
Thank you for riding the Tokyo Death Metro.

Have you been enjoying TDM Battle Rush Season 9 so far?
This season will come to an end on January 5th, 2020.

As the end draws near, we’ll be switching gears to provide you with something even more exciting:

TDM Battle Rush: Season Finale!

To find out more about what’s coming to a train platform near you, please review the following details.

We greatly appreciate your business and hope you continue to enjoy the Tokyo Death Metro’s Luxury Attack Liner!

[b][u]1) Finale Rank Rewards[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0d8987f58e143ae96aaa059ece9ba6c26136af02.jpg[/img]

Players will receive a special blueprint based on their rank at the end of the Season Finale.

Aim for the top as higher ranks will result in better rewards!

[url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/4855/]Click here for more info about how to obtain this season's Battle Rush rewards.[/url]

[b][u]2) Final Sprint – TDM Points INCREASED![/u][/b]
Event period: 11/27/2019 (post maintenance) – 1/5/2020 (maintenance begins)

During the event period, points obtained from successful Raids/Defenses in TDM will be increased by 50%.

Use this opportunity to obtain a lot of points and boost your rank while you still can!

[b][u]3) Concluding Season 9[/u][/b]

Event period: 1/5/2020 (post maintenance) - TBD

TDM Battle Rush Season 9 will end at the start of maintenance on 1/5/2020. Once maintenance has concluded, Season 10 will begin and run over a span of 3 months.

NOTE: At the beginning of the new season, all participants’ TDM ranks will be reduced by 2 and placed at sub-rank III. For example, someone standing at the rank Diamond II at the end of Season 9 will start Season 10 at the rank Gold III.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/29d4a310b16998fcfbf5899bbff65e97b826b3e1.jpg[/img]

-Timber Rebellion Blueprint

-Violent Grinder Body Blueprint

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/f055e6eef356af2baef1cdbdd06264244fcfe5a9.png[/img]

Event Period: 11/6/2019 00:01 - 11/29/19 23:59 (PST)

********UPDATE: 12/13/2019********

Hell yeah, senpai!

The Run For Your Life community speedrun event was a smashing success! Man, some of you really know how to speed your way through the Tower of Barbs! For real, you guys are like, freaky fast! I'm so proud of each and every senpai who participated. LET IT DIE has one of the most amazing communities in all of gaming and it makes your old Uncle D truly happy to see so many of his senpais kicking so much ass!

I wanna give a special thanks to my senpai gr4de_ for going above and beyond the call of duty in organizing and reviewing all of the speedrun submission videos. Without him, well, I guess I would've had to do all the work myself!

Anyway, it's time to announce the big winners!

-1st Place-

vsauce-michael (Steam) - Final time: 1h 05m 01s
Stand_Aside (PS4) - Final time: 1h 12m 06s

Congrats you two! For your super-swift speedruns you'll each win 50 Death Metals, a Premium Skill Decal of your choice, and a LET IT DIE t-shirt!

-2nd Place-

TrustworthyAndy (Steam) - Final time: 1h 09m 10s
Darokyu (PS4) - Final time: 1h 13m 56s

Right on, guys! For your second-place finishes, you'll each receive 30 Death Metals and a LET IT DIE t-shirt.

-3rd Place-

InvisibleMadman (Steam) - Final time: 1h 11m 09s
r072012 (PS4) - Final time: 1h 16m 06s

Nice showing, senpai! You'll each receive 20 Death Metals and a LET IT DIE t-shirt.

Don't forget, if you submitted a speedrun, filled out an entry form, and finished in 4th - 10th place on either platform (PlayStation 4 or Steam/PC) you've also won 10 Death Metals. Good going, yo!

Finally, I gave the event organizer Gr4de_ the opportunity to award an additional 20 Death Metals to a contestant who truly embodied the spirit of the event. He has chosen to award those Death Metals to r072012-senpai for using a lowly Grade 3 Fighter yet still managing to take 3rd place overall on PS4! Double congratulations to you, r072012-senpai! You'll receive 40 Death Metals in total AND a LET IT DIE t-shirt. Way to play, man!

Thanks once again to everyone who participated! Your Uncle D is very proud. Until next time...live fast and DON'T DIE!

********Original Post********

1)  Pumpkinshrooms are Back!

Yo, Senpai.

Momoko told me that those weird lookin’ jack-o-lantern mushrooms are back for this spooky season! They come in bronze, silver, and gold flavors. If you happen to come across one, be sure to snag it while they are still available!

Event Period: 9/30/2019 (Post maintenance) – 11/28/2019 (01:59 PDT)

During the event period, there will be special quests available; including ones to collect Pumpkinshrooms! Check out the Quests at the Hated Arcade or SUPER SCOPE 703 for further details!

How to accept Quests:
By entering the Vanishing Point in the middle of your Waiting Room (the fountain), you will be transported to the HATED ARCADE. There, by talking to Naomi Detox, you can accept Quests from the device next to her. You can also accept quests by using the SUPER SCOPE 703 in your Waiting Room.

It is possible to accept up to 10 quests at a time.

A quest will remain accepted until it is completed or the completion date passes.

notes.title: Refer-A-Fiend Contest! 8/1/2019 - 8/30/2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/7a7554c4f4b8d342e95bb63cf9b01acb3b9ce172.png[/img]

Event Period: 8/1/2019 00:00 – 8/30/2019 2:59 (PDT)

Yo, senpai!

Guess what? I've decided to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/794600/announcements/detail/1616148671791699868]extend the extra special Welcome Bonuses[/url] that were available to new players during the 5 Million Downloads Celebration! On top of that, I'm turning those new player Welcome Bonuses into a contest that will give longtime players a chance to reap some rewards of their own!

I call it...Refer-A-FIEND! Nice, right? Heheheheh!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/fcad994543a7af9b53f2b5a976a74e0917118706.png[/img]

To enter, just refer your friends to the game by tagging them on social media and tell them why they should try LET IT DIE. Once they start playing, get their Player ID and use that info to fill out the official entry form. If just one of the friends you refer to the game is able to make it past the 3rd Floor boss (COEN) on their newly created account, you will receive 10 Death Metals!

Your friends will get off to a fast start with the help of the new player Welcome Bonuses, and if you refer enough friends to the game to be one of our top 3 referrers you'll win some sick prizes and EVEN MORE Death Metals! Hell yeah!

Okay then, that's enough from me. I'll let one of my flunkies fill you in on the rest of the details, and thanks for spreading the word about LET IT DIE!

TO ENTER:
[olist]
[*]Refer your friends to LET IT DIE by tagging them in a social media post using the hashtag #LIDFiendClub (Look closely: there's no 'r' in "fiend")
[*]Once your friend(s) begin playing the game, ask them for their LET IT DIE Player ID number. This number is located in the upper-right corner of the game's title screen.
[*]After you have collected your friend's Player ID(s), fill out [url=https://forms.gle/PGqsGxqmYHwnK3XBA]the official entry form located HERE.[/url]
[/olist]
KEEP IN MIND:
[list]
[*]You can refer as many players to the game as you would like. Each player you refer to the game who...
[/list]
[olist]
[*]You tag on social media in a post using the hashtag #LIDFiendClub
[*]Downloads LET IT DIE and creates a new account
[*]Defeats the 3rd Floor boss (COEN) and arrives on the 4th Floor of the Tower of Barbs
[*]Is accounted for on [url=https://forms.gle/PGqsGxqmYHwnK3XBA]the official Refer-A-Fiend entry form[/url]
[/olist]
...will count as an official referral.
[list]
[*]You can create multiple social media posts and tag multiple friends throughout the course of the contest period.
[*]You can fill out the official entry form as many times as you would like. If you refer two friends to the game via social media and fill out the official entry form one day, then suddenly think of three more friends you'd like to refer to the game the next day, just fill out the entry form again and add the next batch of friends. There is no need to reenter past referrals each time you fill out the official entry form, just add any NEW referrals any time you refer a new friend(s) to the game.
[*]Existing players (that's you) will earn 10 Death Metals when one of their referrals defeats the 3rd Floor boss (COEN). You can only earn this reward ONE TIME. Even if you refer 200 friends to the game and they all make it to the 4th Floor, you can only earn the 10 Death Metals ONCE. These bonus Death Metals will be distributed after the contest has ended.
[*]There is no need for you to keep track of your friends' progress in the game. GungHo staff will handle that part!
[*]If you like, you can use the Refer-A-Fiend banner at the top of this post to spice up your social media posts! Just right-click on the image at the very top of this post, save the image, and place it in your social posts.
[*]The top 3 referrers will win the prizes outlined below.
[/list]
PRIZES:

1st Place (most referrals)
[list]
[*]Death Metal x 100
[*]30-day Express Pass x 1
[*]LID T-shirt (sizes available: S, M, L)
[*]LET IT DIE "Fiend Club" Original Goods (Designs TBD, check back later!)
[*]Participation Award (Death Metal x 10 for your first successful referral)
[/list]

2nd Place (second-most referrals)
[list]
[*]Death Metal x 60
[*]1-day Express Pass x 5
[*]LID T-shirt (sizes available: S, M, L)
[*]LET IT DIE "Fiend Club" Original Goods (Designs TBD, check back later!)
[*]Participation Award (Death Metal x 10 for your first successful referral)
[/list]

3rd Place (third-most referrals)
[list]
[*]Death Metal x 30
[*]1-day Express Pass x 3
[*]LID T-shirt (sizes available: S, M, L)
[*]LET IT DIE "Fiend Club" Original Goods (Designs TBD, check back later!
[*]Participation Award (Death Metal x 10 for your first successful referral)
[/list]
Good luck, and thank you for sharing your love of LET IT DIE with your friends! May the best FIEND win!

※ Event duration and content may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances

notes.title: Celebrate 5 Million Downloads of LET IT DIE!!

Event Period : 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 7/31/2019 2:59 (PDT)

Thanks to goretastic action freaks everywhere, LET IT DIE has reached 5 million downloads worldwide! To commemorate this momentous achievement, the game will be hosting special events throughout July 2019! Brand new players can enjoy special welcome bonuses that will help them get off to a fast start in their quest to conquer the Tower of Barbs, while new and veteran players alike can look forward to powered-up daily log-in rewards and the return of some beloved events from the game’s past. There’s never been a better time to LET IT DIE!
 
[h1]1. Welcome, New Players! We Come Bearing Gifts!![/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 7/31/2019 2:59
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/fcad994543a7af9b53f2b5a976a74e0917118706.png[/img]

During July 2019, all players who register a new LET IT DIE account will receive the items listed below! These gifts come in addition to the exciting daily rewards that all players will receive throughout the 5 million downloads celebration! If you’ve been waiting to join the fun, now is a great time to begin your conquest of the Tower of Barbs!
[list]
[*]KAMAS-A1 assault rifle blueprint
[*]Death Metal x 20
[*]40,000 Kill Coins x 5
[*]Golden Bird x 5
[*]1-Day Express Pass x 5
[*]Vampire Skill Decal (normal) x 1
[*]One Shot One Kill Skill Decal (normal) x 1
[*]Barbarian Skill Decal (normal) x 1
[/list]
[h1]2. Retweet for Rewards![/h1]
 
To help get the word out about all the goretastic fun to be had in LET IT DIE, the game’s official social media channels will be hosting three special retweet campaigns. All players will receive special in-game rewards if the 5 Million Downloads campaign posts receive enough likes, shares, and retweets!
 
For more information, please visit and like the official LET IT DIE Facebook and Twitter pages @LETITDIETheGame.
 
[h1]3. Exclusive NEW Weapon Blueprint![/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 7/31/2019 2:59 (PDT)

Simply log in during the event period to receive a complimentary blueprint for the all-new Lion Knuckles weapon! It’s WILD!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/bfee22498bda78ad0a8be8f515b9ca465c7e3a2b.jpg[/img]

[h1]4. Lit Login Bonuses![/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 7/31/2019 2:59 (PDT)

Super special daily login bonuses will be available throughout July 2019! For a full month, players will receive deluxe items every day!

See the official website for more details about these special login bonuses: https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/4415/

Special Quests will be available throughout July 2019! Not only will you be able to get your hands on the new Sword Dancer armor by taking on a quest to defeat each of the Tower’s four Dons (bosses), there are loads of other juicy new Quests that will allow you to collect all types of rare metals for R&D purposes! Don’t miss these opportunities to power up your gear to another level!

See the official website for more details about these special Quests: https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/4415/

[h1]6. All 4★ and 5★ MushFests![/h1]
Event Period(s): 7/4/2019 19:00 – 7/8/2019 18:59
7/18/2019 19:00 – 7/22/2019 18:59

notes.title: Max-Level Uncapping Limits Raised!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/6af7a7097b1f5cc206a326fcdacc86ae04053dd6.png[/img]

Event Period : 7/1/2019 (post maintenance)

Senpai!

I'm raising the maximum level for Uncapped Fighters and Equipment!  You've never felt power like this before. Your enemies had better watch their backs!

[h1]1. Max Level Uncapping for Fighters[/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance)

Following the maintenance period on 7/1/2019, you will be able to further Uncap your Fighters and power them up more than ever before! Until now, the upper limit for each of your Fighter's stats was level 35, but after this update, all stats will be able to be raised to level 40! Not only that, but you will also be able to add more slots for Skill Decals and increase the storage capacity of your Death Bag!

To Uncap your Fighter, access the Mingo Head in your Waiting Room while playing as a Fighter who has already reached their max level. From there you will be able to see the required materials for Uncapping.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/4b14c11ec8029343fe6d3a545c5fc8f3efabc934.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. Max Level Uncapping for Weapons and Equipment[/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance)

This update will also allow you to further Uncap your weapons and equipment! Your enemies will quiver in fear when they get a load of your max-level gear! Once your weapons/equipment have been upgraded to their current max level of +14/+15 you will then be able to further Uncap them to a max level of +19!!

To Uncap your weapons/equipment visit Choku-Funsha (the weapon/equipment shop in your Waiting Room). From there you will be able to see the required materials for Uncapping.

Note:

*Please note that event duration and content may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances.

notes.notes:

Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 9/29/2019 (maintenance start)

Greetings. Tetsuo’s the name.
Thank you for riding the Tokyo Death Metro.

Once the 7/1/2019 maintenance has concluded, TDM Battle Rush will be entering Season 8. Season 8 will be filled with some thrilling new things, and we’re excited to have you aboard for the journey! To find out more about what’s coming down the track, please review the following details.

We greatly appreciate your business and hope you continue to enjoy Tokyo Death Metro’s Luxury Attack Liner!

[h1]1. Obtain Special TDM Season 8 Rank Rewards![/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 9/29/2019 (maintenance start)

TDM Battle Rush Season 8 will end once maintenance begins on 9/29/2019.
At that time, your final TDM rank will be calculated and you may be eligible to receive a reward based on your rank!

Details on the maintenance times and rewards will be posted at a later date.
Stay tuned for more info in the coming weeks and months!

[h1]2. New Exclusive Equipment Blueprints Added to Lost Bags![/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – TBD

After the 7/1/2019 maintenance period, players will have a chance to find new equipment blueprints inside Lost Bags (items received at random after successful Raids/Defenses in TDM)! Starting in Season 8, you will be able to get your hands on:
[list]
[*]Timber Rebellion (weapon)
[*]Violent Grinder Head
[*]Violent Grinder Body
[*]Violent Grinder Pants
[/list]
Each of these new pieces of equipment can be raised to the 4th tier. Try to obtain them all and test their destructive power for yourself!

[h1]3. Lost Bags: Available Blueprints Updated[/h1]

Once Season 8 begins, the following equipment blueprints will no longer be available in Lost Bags.
[list]
[*]Striker Flail
[*]Kendo Mask
[*]Kendo Body
[*]Kendo Pants
[/list]
[h1]4. TDM Battle Rush Season 8 Quests Starts[/h1]
Event Period: 7/1/2019 (post maintenance) – 9/29/2019 (maintenance start)

Season 8 will feature seasonal quests that rotate on a weekly basis and also ones that require several weeks to complete. Stay tuned for more details in upcoming updates!

Quests can be accepted in the HATED ARCADE by talking to Naomi Detox, or by accessing the SUPER SCOPE 703 in the Waiting Room.

* You can accept up to 10 Quests at once.
* Please keep your Quests accepted until you fulfill all completion conditions.

= What is TDM Battle Rush? =
TDM Battle Rush is an exciting event where - based on the results of your invasions/defenses - your Rank will go up and down. You will receive a reward each week based on your rank, and based on your Final Rank at the end of the season lasting about 3 months, you could receive a super special reward!

Note:
*Please note that event duration and content may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances.

For additional info and images: https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/4417/

notes.title: #SenpaiCalling Contest!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/810810e0caab3db0144d7b065f9b81611bd2a897.png[/img]

Contest Entry Period: 5/31/2019 18:00 (PDT) - 6/16/2019 23:59 (PDT)

Hey, senpai!

For the past few weeks, I’ve been super busy planning an event to celebrate 5 million downloads of LET IT DIE for PlayStation 4 and PC! The celebration is going to be pretty crazy and I have lots of gnarly stuff in store for you, but before I reveal all the details I wanna kick things off with a goretastic new contest!

The contest is called “Senpai Calling”! Catchy, right?

This is your chance to congratulate me on 5 million downloads of LET IT DIE! To enter, just create and upload a video of yourself telling me how you feel about the game. Tell me what you LOVE, tell me what you HATE... tell me all your favorite and least favorite things about the game! You can ask me questions too! Wanna know more about me and all the folks from the Tower of Barbs or the HATED Arcade? Just ask! Seriously senpai, you can ask me just about anything!

I’ll pick some of the best videos among all the entries and respond to them personally in a video of my own. On top of that, I’m going to pick my 3 favorite videos and award prizes to their creators! SICK prizes, senpai! If your video is in my top 3, you’ll not only receive Death Metals and LET IT DIE swag, I’ll also record a custom greeting of your choosing. That’s right, your old Uncle D (AKA Jukka Hildén, “Uncle Death” English-language voice cast) will record himself saying just about anything you want! This might be a bad idea...you guys are probably gonna make me say something weird, huh? Whatever man, it’s a party!

Okay, I’ll let one of my flunkies fill you in on the rest of the rules, but remember senpai, I WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU!! Let’s have fun and celebrate 5 million downloads of LET IT DIE…(probably) the greatest game ever made!

[h1]Contest entry:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Record a short video (2 minutes or less) to congratulate Uncle Death on 5 million downloads, describe your feelings about LET IT DIE, and/or ask questions about the game world and its characters.

[*]Upload your video to YouTube. If you are feeling a little shy you can set your video's visibility to "Private". Make sure not to leave your video "Unlisted", as that will prevent us from seeing it. We will be able to see your entry when you provide us with a direct link to the video in step #4.

[*]Share your video via a social media post (Facebook or Twitter) along with the contest hashtag, #SenpaiCalling. Make sure that your social media profile is set to “public” or else we won’t be able to confirm your official entry.

[*]Fill out the official entry form located here: https://forms.gle/7tYM1rhM9MgNi2oj8
[/olist]
[h1]Keep in mind:[/h1]

This is your opportunity to congratulate Uncle Death, ask him a question, or tell him what you love/hate about LET IT DIE! Feel free to be honest, but remember to also be creative! Also, please try to keep the language used in your video PG-13.

Please shoot your video in a “testimonial” or “confessional” style. Think of it as an opportunity to share a FaceTime/video call with Uncle Death! Try to shoot your videos in an area that’s well lit and doesn’t have a lot of background noise.

Avoid using ANY MUSIC in your video, even if the music is from LET IT DIE! Remember, the idea is that you're having a conversation with Uncle Death. He might not be able to hear you clearly if there is music playing, so PLEASE NO MUSIC in your videos.

Please make sure that a person or people appear in the video and that you/they speak clearly. You are not required to appear in the video, but SOMEONE should! If you are shy, feel free to have a friend join you, or simply feature them as the star of your video. The person who submits the video as their entry will be the only one who can win the prizes (so please keep that in mind if you invite others to be a part of your video), but if you want to ask a friend for some help with the project, please feel free to do so.

Again, creativity and thoughtful questions/observations are the key! Want to wear cosplay? DO IT!! Did you write a song for Uncle Death and want to play it live for him? GO RIGHT AHEAD! Want to tell Uncle Death what you REALLY think? DON’T HOLD BACK! Just remember to have fun, keep it respectful, and be creative!

[h1]Prizes:[/h1]

“Uncle Death” himself (Jukka Hildén, “Uncle Death” English voice cast) will be selecting 3 of his favorite videos to receive prizes! In addition to both physical and in-game prizes, the creators of the top 3 videos as chosen by GungHo Online Entertainment and Jukka Hildén will win an opportunity to have “Uncle Death” record a custom message of their choosing!

[b]1st Prize:[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom greeting from “Uncle Death” (Jukka Hildén, “Uncle Death” English voice cast)
[*]Original Concept Art Print
[*]500 x Death Metal
[*]LET IT DIE T-shirt
[*]Uncle Death Swirly Glasses
[/list]
[b]2nd Prize:[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom greeting from “Uncle Death” (Jukka Hildén, “Uncle Death” English voice cast)
[*]300 x Death Metal
[*]LET IT DIE T-shirt
[*]Uncle Death Swirly Glasses
[/list]
[b]3rd Prize:[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom greeting from “Uncle Death” (Jukka Hildén, “Uncle Death” English voice cast)
[*]200 x Death Metal
[*]LET IT DIE T-shirt
[*]Uncle Death Swirly Glasses
[/list]

notes.title: #DrawTheD Contest: 4/22/2019 - 4/26/2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/0e77010b316bcf1d485ad3a14f94e7b45a11f6f6.png[/img]

Hey, senpai!!

For a while now, I’ve been thinking of changing up my social media avatar. Then it dawned on me; why not hold a contest and ask senpai to create one?!

I give you...my #DrawTheD contest!

Everyone is invited to enter. All you need to do is draw an original picture of me that I can use as my avatar on Facebook and Twitter! notes.notes:

Event Period: 2/27/2019 (post maintenance) – 3/31/2019 (maintenance)

Greetings. Tetsuo’s the name.
Thank you for riding the Tokyo Death Metro.

Have you been enjoying TDM Battle Rush Season 6 so far?
This season will come to an end on March 31st, 2019.

As the end draws near, we’ll be switching gears to provide you with something even more exciting:

TDM Battle Rush: Season Finale!

We greatly appreciate your business and hope you continue to enjoy the Tokyo Death Metro’s Luxury Attack Liner!

[u]1) Finale Rank Rewards![/u]

Players will receive a special blueprint based on their rank at the end of the Season Finale.

Aim for the top as higher ranks will result in better rewards!

[u]2) Final Sprint – TDM Points INCREASED![/u]

During the event period, points obtained from successful Raids/Defenses in TDM will be increased by 50%.

Use this opportunity to obtain a lot of points and boost your rank while you still can!

[u]3) Concluding Season 6[/u]

Event period: 3/31/2019 (post maintenance) – TBD

TDM Battle Rush Season 6, will end at the start of the maintenance scheduled for 3/31/2019. Once maintenance has concluded, Season 7 will begin and run over a span of 3 months.

NOTE: At the beginning of the new season, all participants’ TDM ranks will be reduced by 2 and placed at sub-rank III. For example, someone standing at the rank Diamond II at the end of Season 4 will start Season 5 at the rank Gold III.

[u]4) Changes to Lost Bags[/u]

Once TDM Battle Rush Season 7 begins, the following items will no longer be obtainable from Lost Bags:
[list]
[*]Cyclone Shuriken Blueprint
[*]Evil Wizard Cowl Blueprint
[*]Evil Wizard Coat Blueprint
[*]Evil Wizard Leggings Blueprint
[/list]
If you haven’t gotten them, keep on raiding to get them before they’re gone!

notes.title: Tower of Barbs Uncapping Event: 1/31/2019 – 2/28/2019
notes.notes:

Event period: 1/31 02:00 – 2/28 01:59 (PST)

With last November’s Uncapping update, equipment and fighters became able to reach new heights. To help you reach these new heights, Captain Yotsuyama proudly presents the next “Tower of Barbs Uncapping Event”! Seize the day and be sure to take advantage of this opportunity to beef up your fighters and equipment as you continue your conquest of the Tower of Barbs!

[b]Uncapping Log-in Bonus![/b]

For about 4 weeks, special Uncapping Log-in Bonuses will provide you with fantastic items every day!

[b]One Free Continue per Day![/b]

During the Uncapping Event, if you meet an unexpected death in the Tower of Barbs, you will be given a chance to continue for free once per day.

The free continue will reset at 02:00 each day.

Additional info: [url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/3937/]https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/3937/[/url]

notes.title: Launch Stability Compensation
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/c983d7eb979dcb002a87861bb5d3ceed5dfd74bd.png[/img]

Greetings!

We want to start by saying a heartfelt “thank you” to all of our fans in the Steam/PC community! Since the release of LET IT DIE on PC in September, you have shown our game a tremendous amount of love and support, and provided us with a wealth of valuable feedback and suggestions for improving the player experience. With that said, we know that there have been some growing pains along the way, and we truly have appreciated your patience while we worked to resolve some issues that have made life (death?) tough for some of our players.

With the various patches we’ve released since the game’s launch - including the latest patch, Version 3.4.0 - we believe that we have addressed many of the most common issues affecting players. 

In order to both show our support for our loyal PC players as well as compensate for the instability experienced at launch, we are providing the following bonus items to all accounts created before the maintenance period that took place on 10/31/2018:
[list]
[*] 5x Death Metals
[*] 100,000 Kill Coins
[*] 3x 1-Day Express Passes
[*] 1x Golden Bird
[*] 1x Solo Shelter
[/list] 
Finally, we want everyone to know that we are continuing to work on identifying and addressing any and all lingering issues with the game. If you are continuing to experience gameplay/usability issues, or notice any new issues that affect the normal gameplay experience, please follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/794600/discussions/0/2747650363470798793/] "Troubleshooting" thread [/url]
[*] Check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/794600/discussions/1/] Bugs & Feedback forum[/url] to see if a thread about the issue already exists. If not, make a detailed thread in the forum. Please do not share personal information in these threads.
[*] Follow the instructions below to gather the proper files. If you don't have LOG files don't worry, just send over a DxDiag. Please include the following information when possible:
[list]
[*] 10-Digit User ID
[*] Local time in which the error occurred
[*] Country
[*] Screenshots/Video
[/list]
[*] Put in a detailed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://lid-na.gungho-support.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=360000112552]support ticket[/url] about the problem.
[/olist]
[b] How to find the correct files to submit with your ticket:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Go to your game files location. Right click on LET IT DIE in the Steam application > Select "Properties" > Select the "Local Files" tab > Select "Browse Local Files"
[*] Locate your Log files. Select the "BrgGame" folder > Select the "Logs" folder
[*] Please make a ZIP file of your Logs folder and a DxDiag to include it with your ticket.
[/olist]
Providing these files will help our development team in their investigation.

notes.title: Let It Die s free-to-play money-grubbing fits it perfectly
notes.notes:
There’s this art installation called the Minimum Wage Machine. Between 2008 and 2010 conceptually-motivated artist Blake Fall-Conroy exhibited a box operated by a hand-crank, which spat out a US penny every four seconds, intended to be equivalent of working for the minimum wage in New York at the time. I take this art piece to be about how labour can be completely disengaged from utility. At your job, you create things you don t necessarily even consume. Marx, who had maybe one or two things to say about the role capital plays in culture, would call this “alienation”. How different, really, is turning a crank in an art gallery to lads in factories making electronics they ll never be able to afford? To collecting cocoa beans if you ll never get to eat a Freddo? For years I ve wondered if a big videogame might also try to leverage this kind of financial cynicism through interactivity.

I ve been playing Let It Die this week.

notes.title: Prohibited Actions
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/0e03e423d2a4409a0860e5d0c736bcafba26cc11.jpg[/img]

We’d like to thank all of our players who have been enjoying LET IT DIE and take this opportunity to remind everyone that cheating is not allowed.

[h1]What do we consider cheating?[/h1]
All actions which allow you to gain an unfair advantage or progress through the game using irregular means may be considered “cheating” and are strictly prohibited. This includes anything that subverts the originally intended and implemented game systems.

While not exhaustive, the following list contains some possible examples of prohibited actions:
[list]
[*]Intentional exploitation of in-game bugs
[*]Trading, buying or selling of game accounts
[*]Unauthorized modification of the game
[*]Use of illegal third-party programs
[*]Client/packet modification or editing
[*]Impersonating an employee/developer/admin/community/support/etc.
[*]Promoting cheating or the use of cheating applications to other users
[*]Any other acts deemed inappropriate by the operations team
[/list]

Such actions will be dealt with strictly and at the sole discretion of the LET IT DIE team. This may include a permanent suspension from game services.

[h1]But is it OK to ______ ? [/h1]
The purpose of this notice is not to establish a complete list of restricted behaviors, but rather to provide a clear warning against prohibited actions. If you are unsure if something may be considered cheating, it’s best to avoid it completely.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/794600/discussions/0/1743346190271993571/

[h1]How can I report possible cheating?[/h1]
Please avoid “calling out” users in these forums or other public communities. The best way to report suspicious players is by contacting our support team directly.

Use our [url=https://lid-na.gungho-support.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=360000112552]Support Form.[/url]
Please include the username and a screenshot.

notes.title: Grasshopper s Let It Die cuts into PC
notes.notes:
Befriend a skateboarding reaper, scale a mysterious industrial murderhell tower rising from futureTokyo, murder murdered-out zombies, eat frogs, and loot loot loot in Let It Die, the free-to-play roguelikelike action-RPG from Grasshopper Manufacture. Following its 2016 debut on PlayStation 4, Let It Die launched on PC this morning. As you’d expect from the makers of makers of No More Heroes and Killer7, it’s a bit of a silly one. I’ve played an hour and a half of it today and will at least return to get a better sense of what this procedurally-generated permadeath murderhell even is. First, meet Uncle Death.

notes.title: Free-to-play PS4 hack-and-slasher Let It Die is heading to PC
notes.notes:
UPDATE 17/9/18: Grasshopper Manufacture's wonderfully weird, formerly PlayStation 4-exclusive, hack-and-slasher Let It Die is coming to Steam on September 26th.

As was the case on PS4, it'll be free-to-play on PC, with a variety of in-game purchase options. Let It Die's PC version will also feature a "silky-smooth frame rate and ultra high resolution", according to the game's new Steam listing.

ORIGINAL STORY 13/8/18: Grasshopper Manufacture has announced that its off-kilter, formerly PS4-exclusive hack-and-slasher Let It Die will be making its way to PC this autumn.
